subject: Film & Cinema
title: Electronic and Synth Scores
description: Learn Electronic and Synth Scores in one minute.

hook.text: Vangelis scored Blade Runner with a synthesizer and created the sound of the future.

buildup.text: Electronic scores use synthesizers, samplers, and digital tools instead of orchestras.

discovery.text: Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross won an Oscar for The Social Network's cold digital soundscape.

twist.text: Cheap synth scores flooded '80s B-movies, giving electronic music a bad reputation in film.

climax.text: Today, the best scores blend electronic and orchestral elements seamlessly.

punchline.text: The future of film music has no instruments.

quiz.question: What film established Vangelis' synthesizer score as iconic?
